about_short_description.short_description: Trackingplan is an embedded software platform that provides analytics, tracking, and code quality.

product.name: Trackingplan Analytics Quality Assurance Platform
product.description: A platform that automatically monitors and audits digital analytics, marketing pixels, campaigns, and data layers to detect errors and ensure data quality in real time.

identifier.value: Root Cause Analysis and Debugging Tools

product.name: Root Cause Analysis and Debugging Tools
product.description: Tools within Trackingplan that help identify the origin and cause of data quality issues by analyzing event data and correlations to speed up problem resolution.

identifier.value: Automated Data Validation and Specification Monitoring

product.name: Automated Data Validation and Specification Monitoring
product.description: A system that validates event sequences, property types, and campaign tagging against predefined specifications to ensure data conforms to expected formats and rules.

product.name: Data and Marketing Observability
product.description: Continuous monitoring of all data sent from websites and apps to third-party integrations, providing a comprehensive view of the Martech stack and data flows.

product.name: Integration Ecosystem and API Access
product.description: A broad set of integrations with analytics, marketing, tag management, and CRM platforms, plus APIs for exporting and managing tracking data.
